text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Goooood morning, Trainer! Call me the dancing queen, because I've finally broken through the limits of conventional dancing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Beneath the starlit skies, I came up with the Pearl Tango, a whole new style of body language!

text_block_list.text: Burning the midnight oil allowed me to produce a fantastic result that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears that Seeking the Pearl didn't get a very good night's rest since she spent the night dancing away.
